name: Box MCP server
description: Lets AI agents search, read, and ask questions about enterprise Box files through a hosted MCP server that keeps Box permissions and uses OAuth sign-in.

skills.name: Search Files
skills.description: Searches files by keyword or SQL-like metadata queries, and finds folders by name.

skills.name: Read Files And Folders
skills.description: Returns file content, details, and previews, and lists folder contents with metadata and permissions.

skills.name: Ask Box AI
skills.description: Asks questions about a single file, several files, or a Box Hub with Box AI, returning citations when available.

skills.name: Extract Metadata
skills.description: Extracts freeform or structured metadata from files with Box AI, including against existing metadata templates.

skills.name: Manage Content And Hubs
skills.description: Uploads, copies, and organizes files and folders, adds comments, and creates Box Hubs; some write tools need an admin to turn them on.
